title: WUL Claim V0
description: Typed, truth-tagged, admission-gated WUL symbolic claim. Closed taxonomies enforced here. Passage-law transitions require reducer enforcement — documented in $comment fields.
$comment: PASSAGE LAW (reducer-enforced, not schema-enforced): (1) No promotion above truth_status=SUPPORTED without a non-null evidence_hash. (2) SPECULATIVE claims: max_admission_state ceiling is PENDING_REVIEW (admission) / REVIEWED (truth); may never reach ADMITTED, SEALED, or REPLAYABLE. (3) REJECTED and SUPERSEDED are terminal negative/succession branches — no further transitions allowed from either state.

evidence_hash.$comment: REDUCER ENFORCEMENT REQUIRED: must be non-null for any truth_status above SUPPORTED (REVIEWED, ADMITTED, SEALED, REPLAYABLE). Schema accepts null; reducer must reject promotion without hash.

max_admission_state.$comment: REDUCER ENFORCEMENT REQUIRED: for SPECULATIVE claims, max_admission_state must not exceed PENDING_REVIEW. Reducer must verify admission_state <= max_admission_state at every transition.

terminal.$comment: REDUCER ENFORCEMENT REQUIRED: must be true when admission_state is REJECTED or SUPERSEDED. Must be false for all other admission states.

rejection_reason.$comment: REDUCER ENFORCEMENT REQUIRED: must be non-null when terminal=true.
